name: IMU loss
notes: No IMU means no attitude: R3 needs a healthy IMU

name: Accel saturation
notes: |f| > 0.95 full scale (CoDR 20)

name: Gyro saturation
notes: |w| > 0.95 full scale (CoDR 20)

name: Accel stuck
notes: Windowed variance below the noise floor (CoDR 20)

name: Gyro stuck
notes: Windowed variance below the noise floor (CoDR 20)

name: IMU rate of change
notes: Jerk beyond the physical bound: sample invalid; persistent: suspect (CoDR 20)

name: IMU timing
notes: dt outside [0.5 1.5] x nominal (CoDR 20)

name: Lidar beam 1
notes: Valid flag / range bounds / rate; blind zone masked on the pad (CoDR 21)

name: Lidar all beams
notes: Loss of every beam near the ground: no landing altimetry (fault tree: loss of lidar modules)

name: GPS solution quality
notes: Fix below 3D or <= 6 satellites (CoDR 22)

name: GPS age
notes: Solution older than 200 ms (CoDR 22)

name: GPS jump
notes: |dp - v dt| > k sigma; multipath mask below a set height (CoDR 22)

name: Barometer
notes: Range / rate / stuck; ground-effect window near the pad (PDR 80)

name: Magnetometer
notes: Loss / range (fault tree: magnetometer loss)

name: Loss-of-control bound
notes: Tilt error beyond e1 for T1 (PDR 82): R1 then R2

name: Attitude envelope
notes: Tilt error or pitch/yaw rate beyond the hard limit (roll: row 22): R4 above h_cut else R2 (CoDR 28)

name: Limit cycle
notes: Sign-change count on error rate over a window (PDR 82): R1 then R2

name: Thrust margin
notes: Throttle > 90% of max for longer than T = 1 s (CoDR 27)

name: Roll rate
notes: Roll-rate bound exceeded (PDR 82)

name: Reference integrity
notes: t = 0 reference matches the pad state; checksum at IBIT (CoDR 27)

name: Gimbal saturation (high duty)
notes: Fraction of samples at the limit over 1 s above 0.3 (CoDR 28)

name: Gimbal saturation (sustained)
notes: Fraction at the limit over 2 s above 0.8 (CoDR 28)

name: Gimbal tracking (stuck / slow)
notes: Command vs feedback residual (CoDR 28)

name: Gimbal hardover
notes: Feedback at the limit against the command (CoDR 28)

name: RCS fan health
notes: Delivered vs commanded roll torque (stands in for ESC RPM vs command; the sim has one roll channel)

name: Stuck thrust
notes: T/W < 1.1: land (R2); > 1.1: R4 (PDR 83); bounded dither not modeled

name: IMU pad sanity (IBIT)
notes: |f| ~ g and |w| near noise on the pad (CoDR 20)

name: Lidar pad geometry (IBIT)
notes: Each beam reads the expected pad height (CoDR 21)

name: GPS pad calibration (IBIT)
notes: NED origin calibrated at the pad (CoDR 22)

name: One sensor rejecting
notes: NAVIGATION on: one sensor fails a 99.99 % gate on the NIS the filter reports (fdir_nav_monitors; PDR 81)

name: Several sensors rejecting
notes: NAVIGATION on: two or more sensors fail together; persistent -> R3

name: NIS window / CUSUM
notes: NAVIGATION on: CUSUM of mean normalized NIS above 2 per second (CoDR 24)

name: Main vs shadow estimator
notes: NAVIGATION on: GMEKF vs the shadow vertical estimator (height or vertical velocity apart) -> R3 on the shadow

name: Covariance / state plausibility
notes: NAVIGATION on: covariance or state not finite or beyond bounds (CoDR 25-26)
